name: unifi-fabric
description: Runs the open-source UniFi Fabric MCP server locally (uvx, pinned release) with your own UniFi Site Manager API key, read from UNIFI_API_KEY in the environment that starts Antigravity. Reads and manages UniFi sites, devices, clients, firewall, VPN and Protect cameras through Ubiquiti's cloud API (api.ui.com). Not affiliated with Ubiquiti Inc.
